rationale: With only ~10 minutes left, the long position is barely in profit (0.07%) and sits below both the VWAP and 9‑EMA, indicating limited upside. Reaching the TP ($65.10) would require a move of ~0.8 % in a short time, while the price is already near the day’s low and a drop to the invalidation ($64.40) is plausible. Closing now locks the small gain and avoids the higher risk of a loss.
